verdict.rationale: Codex itself can run as an MCP server via `codex mcp-server`, a JSON-RPC API over MCP that other MCP clients can connect to and use to drive a local Codex engine. That server mode is labelled experimental on GitHub, and the official docs say it is deprecated in favor of the Codex app server, documented only for existing integrations. Missing for 10: a supported, non-deprecated MCP server mode; in-depth docs on the server's tools and capabilities; independent or hands-on corroboration.
